articleDateMeaning: Gallery canonical addedDate is the admission date; publisher first-online date and Evidence capturedAt must not substitute

evidenceRule: Publish only double-checked bilingual summaries supported by captured Article Evidence Packet text. validExistingSummaries: reuse when sourceHash and evidencePacketHash match current captured evidence
catchUpPublication: One existing reviewed-summary pipeline, a single merged authorized publication for completed records, with explicit durable pending reasons for any unprocessed or unverified DOI. No unreviewed mass fill or duplicate scheduled publisher.
